# Hand-written before internal/routes/fiber.go existed. Format: see gin-basic.
# Fiber matches a Use prefix with a plain string prefix test, so Use("/api", Auth) also reaches /apix.
GET /health -> ~/internal/handler.Health |
GET /api/v1/users/:id -> ~/internal/handler.GetUser | external:github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2/middleware/logger.New(h), ~/internal/mw.Auth, ~/internal/mw.Trace
POST /api/v1/users -> ~/internal/handler.CreateUser | external:github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2/middleware/logger.New(h), ~/internal/mw.Auth, ~/internal/mw.Trace, ~/internal/mw.RateLimit$1(h)
ANY /api/v1/any -> ~/internal/handler.Health | external:github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2/middleware/logger.New(h), ~/internal/mw.Auth, ~/internal/mw.Trace
PATCH /api/v1/users/:id -> ~/internal/handler.CreateUser | external:github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2/middleware/logger.New(h), ~/internal/mw.Auth, ~/internal/mw.Trace
GET /apix -> ~/internal/handler.Health | external:github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2/middleware/logger.New(h), ~/internal/mw.Auth
GET /public -> ~/internal/handler.Health | external:github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2/middleware/logger.New(h)
DELETE /api/admin/users/:id -> ~/internal/handler.DeleteUser | external:github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2/middleware/logger.New(h), ~/internal/mw.Auth, ~/internal/mw.Trace
GET /a -> ~/internal/handler.Health | external:github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2/middleware/logger.New(h)
GET /b -> ~.main$2 | external:github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2/middleware/logger.New(h)
GET /v2/users -> ~/internal/handler.GetUser | external:github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2/middleware/logger.New(h)
